description: Create a design draft for a product from a DesignDocumentV3. Returns status "valid" with a signed handoffUrl, or status "invalid" with a list of {path, code, message} errors you can fix and resubmit via update_design. Invalid drafts are still saved so you can iterate.

design.description: A DesignDocumentV3 (mm-native). templateId/templateVersion are set by the service.

name: create_design
